full_text_zh:
[P1] 大棕熊
的
秘密

文 / (英) 凯洛琳·凯索
图 / (美) 提娜·麦克塔格 特 / 涂然
儿童文学博士、作家、儿童阅读推广人 游冰子 推荐

湖南少年儿童出版社

[P2] 一个冬日的黄昏，大棕熊匆匆钻出了森林。
“我有一个秘密！”她一边说，一边微笑起来，“这个秘密非常了不起，非常不可思议，它会让你大声叫，它会让你快活地转圈跳！”

[P3] “那是什么呀？”狐狸问，
“是什么秘密这么棒？是不是好吃的东西？”

“不！不是！”大棕熊急匆匆地说，
“你不会想要吃掉它的，你只会想要好好地抱住它，用鼻子蹭蹭它；你还会想要伸出舌头，从上到下，好好地舔一舔它！”

[P4] “哇，”浣熊在一棵大树后面咂起了嘴巴，
“那是不是一个大冰桃呀？”

“大冰桃，大冰桃，”大棕熊回答，“我看是你有点笨！谁会抱着冰桃用鼻子蹭？我的秘密可不是冷冰冰的。不过，你会想要包裹着它，让它感觉到你的温暖；还会想要一直守护着它，就像守护着你最大的宝藏。”

[P5] “硬壳果！硬壳果！”大棕熊一边叫，一边乐得打了
个转儿，“要是你以为我的秘密是硬壳果，那你可真是个
开心果！我的秘密啊，不是你可以大咬大嚼的东西，你也
不能把它埋在地下，等明年再挖出来吃。”

“那会是什么东西呢？”松鼠问，“告诉我们吧，
好棕熊，那会不会是……一大堆的硬壳果？”

大棕熊说着，表情严肃起来：“不过，你会想要把它
好好地藏起来，不让那些坏家伙发现它，也不让他们有任
何机会，把它从你身边偷走。你瞧着吧！”她说着，瞥了
一眼狐狸，“我绝不会让那样的事情发生。”

[P6] “呀，呀，呀，”猫头鹰叫着，“这真是一个不错的谜语呀！请问，你的秘密会飞吗？

“不，不会！”大棕熊说，“我的秘密不会飞，可是我会把它高高地抛向天空，在它往下掉的时候，我会用结实的胳膊搂住它，不让它离开我。”

[P7] “那个秘密，是不是很小很小的？”
小老鼠问，“小得可以藏在你的怀里？”

“哦，我当然会把它藏在我的怀里。”大棕熊说，“也许你担心我会把它捂坏了，不过我每天都要把它拿出来的，因为我要好好地看着它，一直看着，看着……不然我真不敢相信，我能这样幸运地拥有它。”

[P8] “你的秘密还真是了不起！”小鹿摇晃着脑袋说，
“我真想知道这是个什么样的秘密。”

“它不只是了不起，”大棕熊说，“它是绝无仅有的，它是妙不可言的，它是一种魔法……”

“它是一个奇迹！”

[P9] 夜幕渐渐降临，动物们也渐渐感到倦了，
不想再去猜大棕熊的那个秘密是什么了。
“大棕熊只是在吹牛罢了。”狐狸哼了一声，
“我就不信他有什么秘密，就算有，也不会是什么了不起的秘密。”

[P10] “我同意，”猫头鹰说，“我就对那个秘密不感兴趣，又不能吃，还要去舔……又不能飞，还要去抱……还要把它藏在怀里，这种秘密听上去就不是那么妙。”

其他的动物们也赞同。可当他们回头去找大棕熊的时候，却发现，她已经消失在了冬夜的雾气里。

[P11] 日子一天天过去，冰雪封住了大地。
大棕熊在山洞里缩成一团，有时候，很冷，有时候，很饿。
她经历了风雪、冰雹、黑暗和一些危险的关头，可只要想到那个秘密，大棕熊就会变得坚强起来。
她耐心地等啊等，一直等到整个冬天悄悄过去。

[P12] 大棕熊的秘密，终于，在一个春天来临的日子里，降生了。
他很小，很柔软，就像一个毛茸茸的小球，
他有一对乌溜溜的大眼睛和一个扁扁的小鼻子。
大棕熊用结实的胳膊温柔地搂着他，不让他离开
自己，与此同时，他发出了一个快乐的叫喊声，
这声音穿过了草原，在整个山谷中回荡。
狐狸、松鼠、浣熊、猫头鹰、小鹿、小老鼠，听到
声音，都赶紧来看看发生了什么事……

[P13] 到了这时，他们都不得不承认，大棕熊的秘密，确实非常非常了不起。

[P14] 亲子共读，启发成长智慧

新生命与母爱

一个新生命的诞生对于母亲来说，是一件最奇妙的礼物。
母亲孕育孩子是一个幸福又非常辛苦的过程。每一位母亲都会
把孩子看成是自己生命的延续，都会用她自己那最伟大的母爱
去哺育孩子，让孩子健康成长。而孩子呢，在逐渐长大之后，
也应该懂得用自己的爱去回报母亲。

想一想
1. 关于大棕熊的秘密，森林里的动物都给出了哪些答案？
2. 在谜底没有揭晓以前，你认为大棕熊的秘密是什么？
3. 为什么最后大家都觉得大棕熊的秘密真的非常了不起？

试一试
每年5月的第二个礼拜天是母亲节，这是属于每一位母亲的
节日。请你记住这一天，并在每年的这一天做一件令妈妈开心
的事情；或者是在这一天来临的时候，对妈妈说：“我爱你！”
full_text_en:
[P1] The Secret of Big Brown Bear

Text / (UK) Caroline Kays
Illustrations / (US) Tina McTaggart, Translated by Tu Ran
Recommended by You Bingzi, PhD in Children's Literature, Writer, Children's Reading Promoter

Hunan Children's Publishing House

[P2] One winter evening, the big brown bear hurried out of the forest.
"I have a secret!" she said, smiling, "This secret is wonderful and incredible. It will make you shout loud, and it will make you jump around happily!"

[P3] "What is that?" asked the fox,
"What kind of secret is so wonderful? Is it something delicious?"

"No! No!" said the big brown bear hurriedly,
"You won't want to eat it. You'll just want to hold it tightly, nuzzle it with your nose; you'll also want to stick out your tongue, from top to bottom, and lick it好好地!"

[P4] "Wow," the raccoon whispered behind a big tree, 
"Is that a big ice peach?"

"Big ice peach, big ice peach," the big brown bear replied, "I think you're a bit silly! Who would hug an ice peach and rub it with their nose? My secret isn't cold. But you'd want to wrap it up, so it feels your warmth; and you'd want to protect it always, just like your greatest treasure."

[P5] "Acorns! Acorns!" the big brown bear called out, laughing and spinning around. "If you think my secret is acorns, then you're really a happy little nut! My secret, though, isn't something you can chomp and chew. You can't bury it underground and dig it up again next year either."

"What could it be, then?" asked the squirrel. "Tell us, good bear, could it be... a big pile of acorns?"

The big brown bear spoke, her expression turning serious: "But you'd want to hide it well, so those bad fellows can't find it. You wouldn't let them have any chance to steal it from you. You'll see!" She said, giving the fox a quick glance. "I'll never let that happen."

[P6] "Yah, yah, yah," the owl called out, "This is a wonderful riddle! May I ask, does your secret fly?"

"No, it doesn't!" said the big brown bear. "My secret doesn't fly, but I'll throw it high up into the sky, and when it falls down, I'll catch it with my strong arms and keep it close to me."

[P7] "Is that secret very, very small?" the little mouse asked. "Small enough to hide in your arms?"

"Oh, I would certainly hide it in my arms," said the big brown bear. "Maybe you're worried I might smother it, but I have to take it out every day, because I need to look at it carefully, keep looking, looking... Otherwise, I really wouldn't believe I could be so lucky to have it."

[P8] "Your secret is truly amazing!" the fawn said, shaking its head,
"I really want to know what kind of secret this is."

"It's not just amazing," said the big brown bear, "it's one of a kind, it's wonderful, it's a kind of magic..."

"It's a miracle!"

[P9] Night was falling, and the animals were beginning to feel tired,
no longer wanting to guess what Big Brown Bear's secret was.
"Big Brown Bear is just blowing smoke," the fox huffed,
"I don't believe he has any secret. Even if he does, it wouldn't be anything remarkable."

[P10] "I agree," said the owl, "I'm just not interested in that secret. It can't be eaten, and you have to lick it... it can't fly, and you have to hug it... and you have to hide it in your arms. This kind of secret doesn't sound very wonderful."

The other animals agreed. But when they turned back to look for the big brown bear, they found that she had already disappeared into the winter night's mist.

[P11] Days passed one by one, and ice and snow sealed the earth.
The big brown bear curled up in her cave, sometimes very cold, sometimes very hungry.
She endured blizzards, hail, darkness, and some dangerous moments, but as long as she thought of that secret, the big brown bear would become strong.
She waited patiently, all the way until the entire winter quietly passed.

[P12] The big brown bear's secret, finally, on a day when spring arrived, was born.
He was very small and soft, like a fluffy little ball,
with a pair of big, round eyes and a flat little nose.
The big brown bear gently held him with his strong arms, not letting him leave
himself. At the same time, he let out a joyful cry,
which echoed across the meadow and through the entire valley.
The fox, squirrel, raccoon, owl, deer, and little mouse, hearing
the sound, hurried over to see what was happening...

[P13] At this point, they could not help but admit that the big brown bear's secret was truly, truly amazing.

[P14] Parent-child reading, inspiring growth and wisdom

New Life and Maternal Love

The birth of a new life is the most wonderful gift for a mother.
Motherhood is a happy yet very hard process. Every mother will
regard her child as an extension of her own life, and will use her greatest maternal love
to nurture the child and help them grow up healthily. And as the child grows, they
should also learn to repay their mother with love.

Think About It
1. What answers did the animals in the forest give about the big brown bear's secret?
2. Before the mystery was revealed, what did you think the big brown bear's secret was?
3. Why did everyone finally think the big brown bear's secret was truly amazing?

Try This
The second Sunday in May is Mother's Day, a day belonging to every mother.
Please remember this day, and on this day each year, do something to make your mom happy;
or when this day comes, say to your mom: "I love you!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大棕熊的秘密》的封面，展示了大棕熊、狐狸和松鼠在森林中的插图，并列出了作者、绘者、译者、推荐人及出版社信息。
[P2] 一个冬日黄昏，大棕熊从森林中走出，兴奋地宣布自己有一个令人惊喜的秘密，并描述了这个秘密带来的快乐感受。
[P3] 狐狸好奇地询问大棕熊的秘密是否是好吃的东西，大棕熊急切地解释说，这个秘密不是用来吃的，而是让人想要拥抱、蹭蹭和舔一舔的。
[P4] 浣熊在树后好奇地询问大棕熊的秘密是否是大冰桃，大棕熊笑着解释自己的秘密是温暖的、值得守护的，而不是冰冷的食物。
[P5] 松鼠猜测大棕熊的秘密是一堆硬壳果，大棕熊笑着否认，并强调自己的秘密需要被好好守护，不能被偷走，同时向狐狸表明自己绝不会让秘密被窃取。
[P6] 猫头鹰好奇地询问大棕熊的秘密是否会飞，大棕熊解释说秘密不会飞，但会用结实的胳膊紧紧抱住它，不让它离开。
[P7] 小老鼠询问大棕熊的秘密是否很小，可以藏在怀里；大棕熊回应说他会把秘密藏在怀里，并每天拿出来仔细看，因为太珍贵而不敢相信自己能拥有它。
[P8] 小鹿对大棕熊的秘密表示惊叹并好奇询问，大棕熊形容秘密是绝无仅有的魔法，最后激动地宣布它是一个奇迹。
[P9] 夜幕降临，动物们感到疲倦，不再猜测大棕熊的秘密，狐狸认为大棕熊只是在吹牛，不相信他有什么了不起的秘密。
[P10] 猫头鹰表示对大棕熊的秘密不感兴趣，认为它既不能吃也不能飞，还要藏在怀里，不妙；其他动物也赞同，回头却发现大棕熊已消失在冬夜的雾气中。
[P11] 大棕熊在寒冬的山洞中蜷缩着，忍受着寒冷与饥饿，但只要想到自己的秘密，她就变得坚强，并耐心等待整个冬天过去。
[P12] 大棕熊的秘密——他的小熊宝宝——在一个春天的早晨降生了，大棕熊温柔地抱着他，发出快乐的叫声，其他动物听到声音后纷纷赶来围观。
[P13] 动物们看到大棕熊抱着刚出生的小熊宝宝，终于承认他的秘密非常了不起。
[P14] 本页为绘本的总结与互动页，主题为‘新生命与母爱’，阐述了母亲孕育孩子的艰辛与伟大，以及孩子应懂得回报母爱。页面包含三个思考题和一个母亲节实践活动，引导孩子理解母爱并表达感恩。
